Specifically, CRS-Triage separately evaluates the reliability of structured data and clinical text and then jointly considers the consistency between the two modalities to estimate the confidence of each prediction. Moreover, to reduce the risk of missing high-acuity patients, namely under-triage, CRS-Triage prefers to assign patients slightly higher acuity levels, namely over-triage, by penalizing under-triage errors. Experiments on the MIMIC-IV-ED dataset show that CRS-Triage achieves strong predictive performance. It also provides a better risk-coverage trade-off and remains reliable when the available EHR data are incomplete, degraded, or inconsistent across modalities.

</details>


### [421] [GENESIS: Towards Explainable Causal Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03868)
*Abhinav Thorat,Ravi Kumar Kolla,Vishak K Bhat,Harsh Vardhan Singh Chauhan,Niranjan Pedanekar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出GENESIS，一个可解释的混合因果发现框架，通过将图构建分解为可解释的决策点，确保每一条边的推断都有可审计的证据支撑，实现100%的决策可追溯性，同时在性能上优于纯统计方法并与SOTA LLM辅助方法相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的LLM辅助混合因果发现方法虽然能通过语义推理改善结构恢复，但其推理过程对每条边的决策影响不透明，无法满足实际应用中对每条边的包含或排除进行独立解释的需求。作者将此需求形式化为"决策可追溯性"。

Method: GENESIS框架分两步：首先识别并打分三节点结构基元（链、分叉、对撞），建立透明的结构先验；然后逐步细化图结构，将结构先验与观测证据整合，仅在统计证据不足时调用领域知识。每个边决策都通过可审计的证据来源解决。

Result: GENESIS在所有设置下实现100%的决策可追溯性；在大多数基准数据集上、所有样本量条件下，其SHD指标优于纯统计CD方法，性能与SOTA LLM辅助方法相当。

Conclusion: 该工作将可解释性确立为因果发现中的一等公民目标，证明在追求可追溯性的同时仍能保持竞争力的性能，为因果发现的实际部署提供了新的范式。

Abstract: Causal Discovery (CD) from observational data faces two fundamental challenges. First, purely statistical methods often lack the power to resolve structural ambiguities in low-sample regimes. Second, although LLM-assisted hybrid approaches improve structure recovery through semantic reasoning, the influence of that reasoning on individual edge decisions remains largely opaque. Consequently, existing hybrid methods fail to satisfy a fundamental requirement: explaining why a particular edge is included or excluded in the learned directed acyclic graph (DAG). This is critical in real-world applications, where no ground-truth DAG exists and every structural decision must be independently justified. We formalize this requirement as decision traceability, requiring every inferred edge to be supported by auditable statistical evidence, Markov Blanket consistency, or explicit domain reasoning. We propose GENESIS, an explainable hybrid CD framework that decomposes graph construction into interpretable decision points. GENESIS first identifies and scores three-node structural motifs, including chains, forks, and colliders, to establish transparent structural priors, then progressively refines the graph by integrating these priors with observational evidence, invoking domain knowledge only when statistical evidence is insufficient. By design, every edge decision is resolved through an auditable source of evidence. Experiments show that GENESIS achieves 100% decision traceability across all settings, establishing explainability as a first-class objective in causal discovery. Despite this additional requirement, GENESIS consistently outperforms purely statistical CD methods on the majority of benchmark datasets across all sample regimes in terms of Structural Hamming Distance (SHD), while achieving performance comparable to state-of-the-art LLM-assisted approaches.

</details>


### [422] [Enhancing VLM Reward Models Through Structure-Aware Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03875)
*Pyrros Koussios,Chenhao Li,Xin Chen,Andreas Krause*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SAFT是一种自监督方法，通过LoRA适配器利用任务固有的结构先验来正则化VLM的潜在空间，在无真实监督的情况下在线精炼有噪声的奖励信号，从而稳定文本条件下的强化学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手工设计奖励函数是强化学习的主要瓶颈，虽然VLM可作为奖励模型避免手动设计，但其生成的奖励信号往往噪声大、不可靠，限制了直接部署的实用性。

Method: SAFT（Structure-Aware Fine-Tuning）利用任务的内在结构先验，通过LoRA适配器正则化VLM的潜在空间，在不需要真实监督信号的情况下在线精炼有噪声的奖励信号。

Result: SAFT在多种基础模型能力上均表现出一致性，能持续去噪奖励空间，实现更快的策略收敛，并显著提升与基础模型相比的EPIC距离对齐度。

Conclusion: 奖励失败往往源于结构脆弱性而非语义理解错误；用结构归纳偏置替代大量人工偏好标注，SAFT为稳定文本条件RL提供了可扩展路径，并凸显了任务结构作为通用归纳偏置的价值。

Abstract: Designing effective reward functions remains a major bottleneck in Reinforcement Learning (RL). Recent work uses large foundation Vision-Language Models (VLMs) as reward models, computing text-observation similarity to bypass manual reward engineering. Although promising, these rewards are often noisy and unreliable, limiting their direct utility during deployment. We present Structure-Aware Fine-Tuning (SAFT), a simple, self-supervised method that refines these imperfect reward signals online without access to ground-truth supervision. SAFT leverages intrinsic structural priors to regularize the VLM's latent space via LoRA adapters. We rigorously evaluate SAFT across a spectrum of base model capabilities to demonstrate its versatility. Our results show that SAFT consistently denoises the reward landscape, yielding faster policy convergence and substantially improved alignment (EPIC distance) relative to the underlying base model, suggesting that failures can often be attributed to structural brittleness rather than semantic misunderstanding. By replacing extensive human preference annotation with structural inductive biases inherent to the task, SAFT offers a scalable path for stabilizing text-conditioned RL and underscores the broader value of incorporating task structure as a general inductive bias.

</details>


### [423] [Operationally Feasible Synthetic Power-Grid Scenarios via Learning the AC-Operable Joint Distribution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03878)
*Chenhan Xiao,Xinyu He,Haoran Li,Hanghang Tong,Yang Weng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种可行性感知的分布学习框架，通过分层扩散模型学习AC可运行的电网场景联合分布，生成即满足潮流收敛与运行约束的合成电网场景，无需优化后处理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有合成电网生成方法在生成后通过验证、优化或物理感知生成来提升结构真实性与运行可行性，但生成的场景仍可能AC可行性低、鲁棒性不足，限制了其在下游电力系统研究中的实际应用价值。

Method: 提出可行性感知的分布学习框架：将AC潮流收敛与运行约束嵌入分层扩散模型（hierarchical diffusion）的分布学习中，生成过程分为三个阶段——拓扑与母线属性生成、基于结构的支路参数生成、基于结构与电气特性的负荷曲线生成。

Result: 在基准系统上的实验表明，该框架显著提升了运行可行性与应急鲁棒性，同时保持较强的统计保真度，并消除了基于优化的后处理步骤。

Conclusion: 通过在扩散模型训练阶段直接融入AC可行性约束，使生成器本身能够产生运行可行的电网场景，为合成电网生成提供了一种更高效且实用性的解决方案。

Abstract: Synthetic power-grid scenarios are essential for planning, resilience assessment, contingency analysis, and data-driven power-system applications. Recent synthetic grid generation methods have improved structural realism and operational feasibility by incorporating engineering knowledge through post-generation validation, optimization, or physics-aware generation. However, generated scenarios may still exhibit low AC feasibility and robustness, limiting their practical value for downstream power-system studies. This paper proposes a feasibility-aware distribution-learning framework that learns the AC-operable joint distribution of network topology, branch electrical parameters, and time-varying load profiles. Instead of enforcing feasibility after generation, the proposed framework incorporates AC power-flow convergence and operational constraints into hierarchical diffusion-based distribution learning. This enables the generator itself to produce operationally feasible grid scenarios through efficient diffusion sampling. The hierarchical architecture decomposes the high-dimensional generation task into three engineering-motivated stages: topology and bus-attribute generation, branch-parameter generation conditioned on the generated structure, and load-profile generation conditioned on both network structure and electrical characteristics. Experiments on benchmark systems demonstrate that the proposed framework significantly improves operational feasibility and contingency robustness while maintaining strong statistical fidelity and eliminating optimization-based post-processing.

</details>


### [424] [Omega-S: A Functional Resilience Index for LLM Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03887)
*Alberto Acedo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Omega-S，一种仅基于权重矩阵的正则化惩罚项，用于缓解大语言模型微调时的灾难性遗忘问题。它不需要旧任务数据、Fisher矩阵或旧权重副本，仅需三行代码即可集成到现有训练循环中，额外计算开销不足4%。在Llama-3-8B上用LoRA从代码微调到散文的任务中，Omega-S在HumanEval上保留了更多原始能力（保留率62.9%提升至84.1%），优于无正则化、调参的权重衰减和调参的EWC。论文还揭示了该方法的实际机制是惩罚节点度的方差（而非名义上的Tr(A^3)拓扑项），并量化了重复实验的标准差为0.104，为低秩微调领域的种子对比提供了置信边界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在新区数据上微调时会遗忘先前学到的能力（灾难性遗忘）。现有的缓解方法（如EWC、Fisher矩阵估计、存储旧权重）要么需要额外数据、要么计算开销大。作者希望提出一种轻量级、即插即用的正则化方法，仅利用权重矩阵即可保持旧能力，同时最小化对现有训练流程的干扰。

Method: Omega-S是一种仅从权重矩阵计算得到的惩罚项，基于Tr(A^3)的拓扑构造，但通过实验测量发现，实际起作用的是其中对节点度方差进行惩罚的因子（弹性系数9e-3，其余三个因子弹性低于1e-4）。在LoRA微调中，它表现为对非方阵模块的行幅值和方向对齐的惩罚。该方法仅需三行代码集成到训练循环，额外计算成本低于4%。作者还测试了一种对比保持构造（contrast-preserving）变体，发现其反而使所有10个种子的保留率变差。

Result: 在Llama-3-8B上用LoRA从代码微调到散文的实验中，Omega-S在9/10个种子上保留能力优于无正则化（pass@1从0.173提升至0.238，保留率从62.9%提升至84.1%，sign test p=0.011，Wilcoxon p=0.006）；在全部10个种子上优于调参的权重衰减（p=0.002）；在8/10个种子上优于调参的EWC（p=0.014）。重复相同配置（同种子、同硬件）的保留率标准差为0.104，该方差量化了低秩微调文献中种子对比的置信边界。

Conclusion: Omega-S提供了一种无需旧数据、无需Fisher矩阵、无需旧权重副本的轻量级正则化方案，能显著提升LoRA微调中的能力保留。论文强调诚实报告机制：尽管名义上是拓扑构造（Tr(A^3)），实际梯度只惩罚节点度方差。同时，重复实验的高标准差（0.104）暗示现有文献中种子配对对比的统计显著性需要谨慎解读。代码和所有逐种子结果已公开。

Abstract: Fine-tuning a large language model on new data degrades what it previously learned. We present Omega-S, a drop-in penalty computed from the weight matrix alone: it needs no previous-task data, no Fisher matrix and no stored copy of the old weights. It is three lines in an existing training loop and adds under 4% to the cost of a step.
  Retention. On Llama-3-8B with LoRA, fine-tuned from code to prose and measured by HumanEval over ten seeds, Omega-S retains more of the original capability than no regularisation on 9 of 10 seeds (0.173 -> 0.238 absolute pass@1; sign test one-sided p=0.011, Wilcoxon p=0.006), as a retention ratio, 62.9% -> 84.1%. It also beats tuned weight decay on 10 of 10 seeds (p=0.002) and tuned EWC on 8 of 10 (p=0.014), every arm re-measured in the same session.
  Mechanism, measured rather than asserted. Omega-S is topological by construction, its objective built from Tr(A^3), but we measured which of its four factors actually moves and three do not: their elasticity with respect to the weights is at or below 1e-4, against 9e-3 for the degree-variance term. As implemented, the composite reduces to a penalty on the variance of node degrees, which means row magnitude in square modules and directional alignment in non-square ones. We report this because a method whose name promises one thing and whose gradient does another should say so. We also enumerate the open design choices, including a contrast-preserving construction that does what it was designed to do and makes retention worse on all ten seeds.
  Repeating an identical configuration, same seed and same hardware, gives a standard deviation of 0.104 in retention ratio. We have not found this quantified for low-rank fine-tuning of language models, and it bounds every seed-paired comparison in this literature, ours included.
  Code, per-seed results and the full record of negative results are available.

</details>


### [425] [Cross-Model KV Cache Transfer in LLM Families: A Closed-Form Linear Mapping for Prefill Reuse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03893)
*Taekyung Heo,Rasoul Shafipour,Ritchie Zhao,Maximilian Golub,Mohammad Mahdi Kamani,Ritika Borkar,Makesh Tarun Chandran,Pantea Zardoshti,Bita Darvish Rouhani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出跨模型KV缓存迁移技术，利用不同规模模型间KV对的线性结构，通过闭式岭回归映射器将源模型的KV缓存直接转移到目标模型，跳过prefill阶段，运行速度比重新prefill快2.7-25倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生产部署中经常在不同规模的同族模型间切换（成本-质量级联、对话中切换、路由），每次切换都需要接收方从头进行prefill，造成显著的计算开销和延迟。现有的KV缓存复用仅适用于同一模型，跨模型间缺乏有效的KV传递方案。

Method: 设计了一个逐头（per-head）闭式岭回归映射器，三步完成：（1）为每个目标层选择top-k最具有预测性的源层并拼接其KV作为输入；（2）在映射前剥离RoPE位置编码，使拟合与位置无关且可跨上下文长度复用；（3）在500条FineWeb-Edu序列（每条1024 token）的小规模校准集上拟合岭回归。对于线性映射失败的配对，引入非线性MLP进行恢复。

Result: 在三个模型家族的六对模型上，线性映射器在四对上保留了73-98%的独立prefill准确率，两对退化严重；非线性MLP在失败案例上可恢复高达+37个百分点（HellaSwag保留率）。映射器运行速度比重新prefill快2.7-25倍，且在多轮切换中保持稳定。

Conclusion: 跨模型KV缓存迁移是可行的，跨模型KV存在显著的线性结构（如Qwen3 14B→32B中单一源层可解释目标键的56%方差）。该方法使跨模型切换无需重新prefill，在保持准确率的同时大幅减少延迟和计算开销，使跨模型KV缓存迁移在实际生产中具有实用性。

Abstract: Production deployments often swap between different-sized models in a family for cost-quality cascading, mid-conversation switching, and routing, and each swap forces the receiver to repay the prefill from scratch. We propose cross-model KV cache transfer, where the receiver reuses the source's KV cache, skipping prefill. We find that cross-model KV has substantial linear structure across matched-KV pairs, where source and target share KV head count and per-head dimension. On Qwen3 14B->32B, one source layer explains 56% of variance in the target's keys and 32% in values, rising to 79% and 65% with multiple source layers. Building on this, we design a closed-form ridge mapper that operates per head and proceeds in three steps. First, for each target layer we select the top-k most predictive source layers and concatenate their KV as input. Second, we strip RoPE from the keys before mapping, so the fit is position-free and reusable across context lengths. Third, we fit ridge regression on a small calibration set of 500 FineWeb-Edu sequences of 1,024 tokens each. Surprisingly, across six pairs in three families, this linear mapper retains 73-98% of the receiver's standalone-prefill accuracy on four pairs, while two degrade sharply. A nonlinear MLP recovers up to +37 pp HellaSwag retention on the failures. The mapper runs 2.7-25x faster than re-prefill and remains stable across multi-turn handoff, making cross-model KV cache transfer practical.

</details>


### [426] [Sparse Weight Decomposition for Efficient Circuit Extraction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03913)
*Chuanhao Yan,Xuhan Huang,Yawen Duan,Zhenfei Yin,Hang Zhao,Bryan Dai,Jie Fu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出稀疏权重分解（SWD），通过对预训练模型的权重矩阵进行双稀疏因子分解，在不训练替代网络的情况下获得可寻址的电路单元，用于机制可解释性分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 密集预训练Transformer无法自然暴露可解释的电路单元，现有方法需要学习辅助稀疏表示或训练稀疏模型，计算开销大且可能引入保真度差距。

Method: 将预训练线性投影的权重矩阵分解为两个稀疏因子，共享的中间坐标作为可单独寻址的电路单元，无需训练替代网络即可支持评分、选择和消融等电路提取流程。

Result: 单矩阵替换下，SWD以不到1%的训练数据达到与Transcoder等强基线相当的保真度；在匹配保真度下，以更少的激活读/写边和选定单元达到相同的电路充分性和必要性目标；支持全模型替换；还有零数据变体。

Conclusion: SWD提供了一种高效且高保真的电路提取方法，消除了对替代网络的依赖，并在GPT-2、Qwen2.5和Qwen3.5-27B等多模型上验证了有效性。

Abstract: Dense pretrained transformers do not naturally expose interpretable units for circuit extraction. Existing approaches obtain such units by learning auxiliary sparse representations or training sparse models, incurring substantial additional computation while potentially introducing a fidelity gap between the representation being analyzed and the original pretrained model. We propose Sparse Weight Decomposition (SWD), which reparameterizes pretrained linear projections by factorizing each weight matrix into two sparse factors whose shared intermediate coordinates serve as individually addressable circuit units. Without training a separate replacement network, this parametric representation supports the same scoring, selection, and ablation circuit extraction workflow used for methods that learn sparse features. Across single-matrix replacements, SWD matches the held-out fidelity achieved by Transcoder and other strong baselines while using less than 1% of the data that those baselines use to train their replacements. For matched replacement fidelity, SWD reaches the same circuit sufficiency and necessity targets with fewer active read/write edges and selected units across tasks on GPT-2, Qwen2.5, and Qwen3.5-27B. We further show that SWD remains effective for full-model replacement of all attention and MLP weight matrices after fine-tuning the nonzero factor values. Finally, SWD also features a zero-data variant, allowing broader use of mechanistic interpretability analysis (e.g., per-step analysis).

</details>


### [427] [Trajectory inference via Acceleration Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03916)
*Bartolo Dazzini,Giovanni Conforti,Alain Durmus,Aram-Alexandre Pooladian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为Acceleration Matching (AM)的新算法，用于轨迹推断问题，通过将插值问题提升到相空间并回归到显式条件加速度场，从而避免昂贵的预处理和模拟训练，在多个基准测试中表现出竞争力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 轨迹推断是许多科学领域的基本问题，但现有算法存在计算挑战：要么依赖预处理子程序来强制平滑性，要么依赖基于模拟的训练目标，两者都可能代价高昂。

Method: 提出Acceleration Matching (AM)算法，将原始插值问题提升到相空间（phase space），然后回归到一个显式的条件加速度场，该场可生成随机、平滑且与给定边缘分布一致的轨迹。训练仅需要位置数据，避免轨迹模拟和昂贵的预处理。

Result: 在多个现有文献中的基准问题上提供了充分的数值证据，表明AM与现有算法相比具有竞争力或更优的性能。

Conclusion: AM算法通过创新的相空间提升和条件加速度场回归方法，有效克服了现有轨迹推断算法的计算瓶颈，为该领域提供了更高效的解决方案。

Abstract: Trajectory inference is a fundamental problem in many scientific domains: given a collection of unpaired snapshots of observations at discrete time points, the goal is to generate smooth trajectories that best resemble and interpolate the data. Existing algorithms exhibit computational challenges: they either rely on preprocessing subroutines to enforce smoothness or on simulation-based training objectives, both of which can be expensive. In order to overcome these limitations, we propose a new algorithm called Acceleration Matching (\texttt{AM}). Our approach consists of lifting the original interpolation problem to phase space and then regressing onto an explicit conditional acceleration field that induces random, smooth trajectories that agree with the prescribed marginals. Importantly, our resulting training algorithm only requires positional data, avoids trajectory simulation during training, and is devoid of expensive preprocessing. We provide ample numerical evidence suggesting that \texttt{AM} is competitive with or superior to existing algorithms on several benchmark problems from the existing literature.

</details>


### [428] [PRISM: Powerful Time Series to Image (TS2I) Representations for Multivariate Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03926)
*Mateusz Smendowski,Kamil Faber,Piotr Nawrocki,Nathalie Japkowicz,Roberto Corizzo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PRISM是一个即插即用的元工作流，系统性地构建和评估基于图像表示的多变量时间序列异常检测方法。通过超过7000个实验验证，PRISM配置在14个数据集中的10个上达到最优VUS-PR，平均提升41%，并发现了通道化这一关键设计维度，提出MSM统计方案获得11-27%的性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列异常检测（TSAD）性能对表示选择高度敏感，特别是在多变量场景下。虽然将时间序列转换为图像在预测和分类任务中已取得成功，但在TSAD中如何将多变量高维序列映射到多通道图像以及视觉骨干网络是否能匹配时域基线方法仍不明确。

Method: 提出了PRISM，一个即插即用的元工作流，用于系统性地构建和评估基于图像表示的多变量TSAD方法。同时识别出"通道化"（multi-channel图像通道维度的构建方式）这一关键且此前研究不足的设计维度，并引入MSM（一种基于统计的方案）用于通道构建。

Result: 在超过7000个实验中，PRISM配置在14个数据集中的10个上达到最优VUS-PR，平均提升41%。MSM方案相比PCA替代方案获得11-27%的性能提升。ImageNet预训练编码器可有效迁移到TSAD，冻结编码器保留92%的微调性能且训练速度快1.8倍。

Conclusion: 基于图像的表示方法在多变量TSAD中具有竞争力，通道化是关键设计维度，MSM方案和ImageNet预训练迁移均能有效提升性能。

Abstract: Time series anomaly detection (TSAD) underpins applications in predictive maintenance, finance, and cloud computing, however performance remains sensitive to representation choices, especially in multivariate settings. While transforming time series into images has shown success in forecasting and classification, it remains unclear how multivariate, high-dimensional series should be mapped to multi-channel images and whether vision backbones can match time-domain baselines in TSAD. We introduce PRISM, a plug-and-play meta-workflow enabling systematic construction and evaluation of image-based representations for multivariate TSAD. Our evaluation spanning over 7,000 experiments shows that well-designed PRISM configurations are competitive with 24 time-domain baselines, achieving the best VUS-PR on 10 of 14 datasets, with an average improvement of 41% over the best competing method on those datasets. Further, we identify channelization - how the channel dimension of multi-channel images is constructed - as a critical and previously understudied design dimension, and introduce MSM, a novel statistics-based scheme achieving 11-27% gains over PCA-based alternatives. Finally, ImageNet-pretrained encoders transfer effectively to TSAD, with frozen encoders retaining 92% of fine-tuned performance while training 1.8 times faster. Our code is available at: https://github.com/Smendowski/PRISM.

</details>


### [429] [A Physics-Flavored Transformer Network for Parametrizing Contraction Dynamics of Engineered Skeletal Muscle Tissues](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03927)
*Mattias Luber,Timo Betz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种物理风味神经网络（PFNN），将拉伸指数物理模型集成到CNN-Transformer架构中，用于自动化骨骼肌组织（ESMs）的动力学表型分析，通过混合训练范式（合成数据预训练+无监督自对齐）解决标注数据稀缺问题，实现高保真的力-时间曲线参数化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工程化骨骼肌组织在疾病建模和药物筛选中的功能表征过于依赖峰值力等简单指标，忽略了关键的动力学信息。虽然机理模型可以捕捉这些动力学特性，但其数学复杂性阻碍了规模化应用和广泛采用。

Method: 提出物理风味神经网络（PFNN），将拉伸指数物理模型集成到CNN-Transformer架构中，直接从力-时间曲线提取具有物理意义的参数。采用混合训练范式：先在合成数据上建立"物理直觉"，再在未标注的真实数据上进行无监督自对齐。

Result: 该物理风味方法在多种收缩表型和细胞系（包括杜氏肌营养不良症模型）上实现了高保真参数化，展示了可扩展、自改进的流水线如何弥合理想生物物理学与噪声体外数据之间的差距。

Conclusion: 该工作为高通量生物物理研究提供了稳健工具，弥合了理想化生物物理学与真实体外噪声数据之间的鸿沟，实现了可扩展的自动化骨骼肌动力学表型分析。

Abstract: Engineered Skeletal Muscle Tissues (ESMs) have become a key structure for biomedical disease modeling and pharmacological screening, yet their functional characterization often relies on simplistic metrics like peak force, discarding critical kinetic information. This is partially due to the high level of mathematical complexity which mechanistic models introduce to capture these dynamics. Hence, exactly the complexity prevents scalable application and widespread adaptation in the field. Here we present a Physics-Flavored Neural Network (PFNN) that automates the kinetic phenotyping of ESMs. Our architecture integrates a stretched-exponential physical model into a CNN-Transformer, enabling the extraction of physically meaningful parameters directly from force-time profiles. To address the scarcity of labeled biological data, we employ a hybrid training paradigm: the model develops a "physical intuition" on synthetic data before undergoing unsupervised self-alignment on unlabeled real-world measurements. Our results demonstrate that this physics-flavored approach achieves high-fidelity parameterization across diverse contractile phenotypes and cell lines, including Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy models. Our scalable, self-improving pipeline bridges the gap between idealized biophysics and noisy \emph{in vitro} data, providing a robust tool for high-throughput biophysical research.

</details>


### [430] [Latent Reward Registers for Diffusion Preference Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03929)
*Yuanshen Guan,Zipeng Feng,Zhiwei Xiong,Peiqin Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Latent Reward Registers机制，通过向冻结的Diffusion Transformer输入序列中预置可学习的无位置寄存器token，直接从中间噪声潜在表示中估计终端奖励，解决了扩散模型多步去噪过程中的时间信用分配问题，并在此基础上提出了两种对齐策略：训练用的RG-OPD和推理用的RGS，在效率和性能上均超越现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型与人类偏好对齐通常依赖在最终生成样本上评估的稀疏终端奖励，这给多步去噪过程带来了严重的时间信用分配挑战。作者希望直接从中间噪声潜在表示中估计终端偏好，以实现密集且可微分的奖励信号。

Method: 该方法包含三个核心组件：(1) Latent Reward Registers——在冻结的DiT输入序列中预置可学习的、位置无关的寄存器token，作为独立读出头从中间噪声潜在变量中提取奖励证据，不改变生成器的隐藏状态或速度场；(2) RG-OPD（训练策略）——沿on-policy轨迹蒸馏奖励引导的更新，避免标准策略梯度中的昂贵rollout；(3) RGS（推理策略）——通过幅度匹配的奖励梯度引导采样轨迹，无需参数更新。

Result: 在高噪声水平(u=0.8)下，寄存器在评估的潜在奖励模型中达到最高配对准确率。RG-OPD优于在线强化学习基线，同时GPU训练时间减少高达33倍。RGS在无训练方法中达到新的最优水平，严格提升了对齐度和感知质量指标。

Conclusion: Latent Reward Registers通过从中间噪声潜在表示中直接提取密集奖励信号，有效解决了扩散模型对齐中的时间信用分配问题，并在训练效率和推理性能两方面都取得了显著提升，展示了从中间层获取奖励证据的潜力。

Abstract: Aligning diffusion models with human preferences usually relies on a sparse terminal reward evaluated on the final generated samples, presenting a severe temporal credit-assignment challenge across the multi-step denoising process. We propose Latent Reward Registers, a mechanism that estimates terminal preference directly from intermediate noisy latents by prepending learnable, position-free register tokens to the input sequence of a frozen Diffusion Transformer (DiT). This independent readout mechanism extracts latent reward evidence without altering the generator's hidden states or velocity field. The resulting dense, differentiable reward signal throughout the full denoising process facilitates two alignment strategies. For training, Reward-Gradient On-Policy Distillation (RG-OPD) distills reward-guided updates along on-policy trajectories, bypassing the computationally expensive rollouts of standard policy gradients. For inference, Reward-Guided Sampling (RGS) steers trajectories via magnitude-matched reward gradients without parameter updates. Empirically, at high noise levels (u = 0.8), the registers reach the highest pairwise accuracy among the evaluated latent reward models. Furthermore, RG-OPD outperforms online reinforcement learning baselines while reducing GPU hours by up to 33x, and RGS establishes a new state-of-the-art among training-free methods, strictly enhancing both alignment and perceptual metrics. Code and weights are available at https://github.com/Guanys-dar/latent-reward-register

</details>


### [431] [Muon Meets Mamba: Spectral Optimization for State Space Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03941)
*Arslan Battalov,Karim Kramin,Alexander Markotenko,Sofia Sinitsina*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文对比了Muon优化器与AdamW在Mamba-2 130M状态空间模型上的表现，发现Muon的优势是局部化的：仅在输出投影上使用Muon效果最佳，优于在输入投影或两者同时使用。该优势主要体现在token效率上，且与条件数无关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Muon优化器在Transformer模型上有大量证据支持其有效性，但在状态空间模型（如Mamba）上的行为几乎没有被报告过。作者希望填补这一空白，系统性地评估Muon在非Transformer架构上的表现。

Method: 在Mamba-2 130M模型上，采用受控实验协议，仅改变哪些权重组使用Muon训练（输出投影、输入投影、或两者），与AdamW进行对比。在两种语料库和两种token预算下进行评估，并测试超出计算最优点的长时间训练。

Result: Muon在输出投影上单独使用即优于在输入投影或两者同时使用；优势主要体现在token效率上，在多种条件下保持一致；Muon确实降低了所训练投影的条件数，但条件数更好的输入投影并未带来收益，说明条件数不是性能提升的原因。

Conclusion: Muon在状态空间模型上的收益是局部化的且集中在输出投影，其机制不能简单用条件数改善来解释，需要进一步研究其真正的作用机制。

Abstract: Muon is a recent optimizer that orthogonalizes the update to each weight matrix with a Newton-Schulz iteration, which performs steepest descent under the spectral norm. Almost all the evidence for it comes from Transformer models, and its behavior on state-space models is largely unreported. We compare Muon with AdamW on Mamba-2 130M under a controlled protocol that varies only which weight groups are trained with Muon. The benefit is localized. Muon on the output projection alone beats Muon on the input projection or on both. The advantage is mainly one of token efficiency. It holds on two corpora and two token budgets, and persists when training continues well past the compute-optimal point. Conditioning does not explain the gain. Muon lowers the condition number of whichever projection it trains, but the better-conditioned input projection is not the one that helps.

</details>


### [432] [Assessment of Conditional Diffusion Model for Synthetic Histopathology Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03990)
*Seyed Kahaki,Shijie Li,Weijie Chen,Nicholas Petrick*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了合成组织病理学图像质量评估指标，提出使用病理学预训练基础模型改进FID和IS指标，实验表明改进后的指标与下游分割任务性能相关性更高，且数据多样性比视觉保真度对下游任务更重要。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有合成组织病理学图像评估指标（FID、IS）依赖ImageNet预训练特征提取器，可能不适用于医学图像领域，缺乏对合成数据质量的充分评估。

Method: 提出使用数字病理数据集预训练的基础模型替代ImageNet特征提取器，修改FID和IS指标，并结合precision-recall指标；使用条件去噪扩散模型在四个基准数据集上训练，采用两步训练方法生成具有系统性质量差异的合成数据集，并与下游细胞核分割性能（AJI+、Dice）进行相关性分析。

Result: 病理学特定指标具有更好的判别力。改进的IS指标与下游任务性能相关性更高（r=0.6096，p=0.0122），而原始IS相关性很低（r=0.0708，p=0.7944）。增加训练数据多样性比提高单张图像视觉保真度对分割模型性能影响更大。

Conclusion: 现有的通用生成图像评估指标在病理学领域存在局限性，需要领域特定的评估方法。合成数据的多样性对下游任务性能的提升更为关键，这为计算病理学中的合成数据生成策略提供了重要指导。

Abstract: Synthetic histopathology image generation has emerged as an approach that may address data scarcity in computational pathology, yet current evaluation methodologies may not fully assess synthetic data quality for medical applications. This work investigates and addresses limitations in existing evaluation metrics, investigating an approach for assessing synthetic histopathology image quality through domain-specific metrics and downstream task validation. We show that conventional synthetic data evaluation metrics such as Frechet Inception Distance (FID) and Inception Score (IS) may have limitations when applied to histopathology images due to their reliance on ImageNet-pretrained feature extractors. To address these limitations, we propose for consideration modified FID and IS approaches utilizing foundation models pretrained on digital pathology datasets, supplemented by precision-recall based metrics as part of an additional quality assessment. Using conditional denoising diffusion models trained on four benchmark datasets, with a two-step training approach, we generated synthetic datasets with systematically varied quality characteristics. We also measured the correlation between the synthetic data quality metrics with downstream nuclei segmentation performance using common metrics including the aggregated Jaccard index (AJI+) and the Dice coefficient. The study results suggest that pathology-specific metrics may provide improved discriminative power. Specifically, the modified Inception Score indicates higher correlation with downstream task performance (r=0.6096 with AJI+, p=0.0122), compared to the original IS (r=0.0708, p=0.7944). Our observations indicate that increasing the variety of generated training data has a higher positive correlation with segmentation model performance than improving the visual fidelity of individual generated images.

</details>


### [433] [Test-Time Scaling in Reasoning LLMs: Inference Regimes, Evaluation, and Reproducibility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.04001)
*Mohsen Hariri,Weicong Chen,Nahal Shahini,Vikash Singh,Kai Ye,Amirhossein Samandar,Debargha Ganguly,Sreehari Sankar,Yanyan Zhang,Shouren Wang,Jerry Peng,Biyao Zhang,Michael Hinczewski,Vipin Chaudhary*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统地阐述了测试时缩放（test-time scaling）的理论框架，将其形式化为自回归模型隐式前缀树上的预算推理，区分了三种结构范式（单轨迹顺序缩放、叶级缩放与聚合、前缀级缩放），并提出了评估原则和可复现性要求，同时发布了超过20亿条完整推理轨迹的数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 测试时缩放涵盖了多种推理算法（单轨迹扩展、采样候选聚合、搜索部分状态），但这些算法在统计结构、计算核算和失败模式上存在显著差异。目前将这些过程视为可互换的单一标量"预算"，或在报告准确率时不说明推理协议，导致跨研究结果难以比较。

Method: 沿着三个轴展开：1) 将测试时缩放形式化为隐式前缀树上的预算推理，区分三种结构范式；2) 将评估对象视为整个推理系统，提出区分系统级性能与候选库诊断的评估原则，引入评估剖面（evaluation profile）；3) 明确推理协议的可复现性要求，区分精确重放与分布级可复现性。

Result: 开发了评估剖面，其坐标和简单函数可恢复或界定常见的重复采样指标；规定了协议匹配的计算与不确定性报告方式；组织了开放权重推理生态系统；在知识广度、符号推理和竞赛数学基准上应用了这些原则；发布了超过20亿条完整推理轨迹。

Conclusion: 测试时缩放算法不应被当作可互换的，需要按其统计结构和计算协议进行区分报告；系统的评估框架和可复现性标准对于该领域的可比较研究和健康发展至关重要。

Abstract: Large language models can solve substantially harder reasoning problems with more inference-time compute. The term "test-time scaling," however, now covers diverse inference algorithms that extend deliberation along a single trajectory, sample completed candidates and aggregate them through voting or verification, or search over unfinished partial states. These algorithms differ in their statistical structure, compute accounting, and failure modes. Treating these procedures as interchangeable under a single scalar "budget," or reporting accuracy without the inference protocol that produced it, makes results difficult to compare across studies. We develop a systematic account of test-time scaling along three axes. First, we formalize test-time scaling as budgeted inference over the implicit prefix tree of an autoregressive model and distinguish three structural regimes: single-trajectory sequential scaling, leaf-level scaling with terminal reduction, and prefix-level scaling. Second, we treat the evaluated object as the entire inference system and develop evaluation principles that separate end-to-end system performance from candidate-bank diagnostics. We introduce an evaluation profile whose coordinates and simple functionals recover or bound common repeated-sampling metrics, and prescribe protocol-matched reporting of compute and uncertainty. Third, we specify reproducibility requirements for inference protocols, distinguishing exact replay from distributional reproducibility and identifying the artifacts needed to support each. We also organize the open-weight reasoning ecosystem by model-side and interface mechanisms, apply these principles to broad-knowledge, symbolic-reasoning, and competition-mathematics benchmarks, and assemble over 2 billion full reasoning traces for release with progressively richer verifier and token-level signals.

</details>


<div id='cs.MA'></div>

# cs.MA [[Back]](#toc)

### [434] [Everyone Conforms, No One Believes: Pluralistic Ignorance in LLM Agent Populations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02758)
*Yashwanth YS*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文研究基于LLM的多智能体系统能否复现"多元无知"（pluralistic ignorance）这一社会现象，发现该现象在LLM智能体群体中稳健涌现，但级联性规范变革极少发生，提示LLM模拟可能高估社会规范的稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM多智能体系统被广泛用于模拟社会动态，但尚不清楚其能否捕捉"多元无知"——一种多数人私下反对规范却公开遵从、各自以为只有自己持异议的社会状态。这一现象驱动规范持久性、社会运动和革命，验证其能否被复现对于评估LLM社会模拟的有效性至关重要。

Method: 构建了涵盖10个领域、5个权威等级的100个场景基准（基于人类多元无知文献），评估来自6个组织的8个模型。测试智能体公开遵从率、私下游离程度，并检验单个"规范创业者"公开异议能否打破虚假共识；同时进行提示组件消融实验以区分涌现性遵从与指令驱动遵从。

Result: 智能体公开遵从率达64%-94%尽管私下反对规范；遵从行为具有领域敏感性（工作场所和社交关系场景接近普遍遵从）且高度依赖模型但与其能力无关。7/8模型的级联成功率低于26%，一个模型在所有场景零级联；GPT-4o例外为48%。消融实验显示移除虚假共识框架和合群目标后遵从率仍为52%-92%，说明遵从是涌现而非指令驱动的。

Conclusion: 模型选择是影响模拟结果的未被充分认识的自由度；LLM模拟可能系统性高估社会规范的稳定性，缺失真实社会中驱动规范变革的脆弱临界点动态。

Abstract: LLM-based multi-agent systems are increasingly used to simulate social dynamics, from opinion formation to collective decision-making. These simulations can reproduce certain social phenomena, but it is unknown whether they capture pluralistic ignorance, a state where a majority privately rejects a norm yet publicly conforms, each believing they are alone in dissenting. This phenomenon drives norm persistence, social movements, and political revolutions. We show that pluralistic ignorance emerges robustly in LLM agent populations. We construct a benchmark of 100 scenarios across 10 domains and 5 authority levels, grounded in the human pluralistic ignorance literature, and evaluate 8 models from 6 organizations. Agents publicly conform at rates of 64 to 94% despite privately opposing the norm. Conformity is domain-sensitive (workplace and social relationship scenarios produce near-universal compliance) and highly model-dependent, though uncorrelated with capability. We test whether a single "norm entrepreneur" can break the false consensus by publicly dissenting. For 7 of 8 models, cascades succeed less than 26% of the time, with one model showing zero cascades across all scenarios. GPT-4o is a notable outlier at 48%, revealing qualitatively distinct dynamics across model families. A prompt component ablation across all 8 models establishes that conformity is emergent rather than instruction-driven: removing both the false-consensus framing and fit-in goal reduces conformity but does not eliminate it (52 to 92% in the minimal condition). Our findings identify model selection as an unacknowledged degree of freedom that fundamentally shapes simulation outcomes. More broadly, the near-absence of cascades suggests LLM simulations may systematically overestimate the stability of social norms, missing the fragile tipping-point dynamics that drive real-world norm change in human societies.

</details>


### [435] [Stateful Governance for Concurrent Agentic Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02764)
*Yuxiang Peng,Xiaodi Wu*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文研究了并发智能体系统的有状态治理问题，识别出"过期授权"（stale authorization）这一核心失败模式，并提出Provenact运行时架构，通过策略状态可串行化（policy-state serializability）保证已提交的效果在发生时仍基于最新的策略状态被授权。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI智能体正从咨询接口转向执行关键操作（退款、库存预留、云资源配置、金融转账等），这些工作流需要对效果进行治理而不仅仅是对模型输出进行治理。现有安全机制在请求时点做决策，但对于有状态策略，预算、库存、审批状态和风险信号可能在效果发生前发生变化，导致授权或审批过期失效。

Method: 作者定义策略状态可串行化（policy-state serializability）作为正确性条件，要求已提交的效果可解释为在效果发生前立即针对最新策略状态进行的授权。在此基础上提出Provenact运行时架构，将策略保持为可审查的程序，同时协调保证策略决策所需的状态和效果。原型基于PostgreSQL实现。

Result: 实验表明：Provenact能防止基线方法（将策略状态作为普通请求上下文传递）遗漏的过期授权；在无关工作并发进行时保留延迟审批；策略演化主要体现在策略文本而非受信提供商代码中；在脚本化的无LLM采购工作流中避免策略违规，而智能体治理基线在共享预算和库存上产生过期授权。

Conclusion: Provenact为将状态化治理边界集成到智能体框架和提供商领域提供了一条可行路径，使智能体在共享资源上执行操作时具备可靠的效果治理保障。

Abstract: AI agents are moving from advisory interfaces into systems that execute consequential operations: issuing refunds, reserving scarce inventory, provisioning cloud resources, and initiating financial transfers. These workflows require governance over effects, not only over model outputs. Existing safeguards often decide whether an action is allowed from the information available when the action is requested. For stateful policies, that request-time view may be incomplete: budgets, inventory, approval status, and risk signals can change before the effect occurs, making an earlier authorization or approval stale.
  This paper studies stateful governance for concurrent agentic systems. We identify stale authorization as the core failure mode and define policy-state serializability, a correctness condition requiring committed effects to be explainable as authorized against the policy state immediately before they occur. We present Provenact, a runtime architecture that keeps policies as reviewable programs while coordinating the state and effects needed to preserve their decisions. In experiments with a PostgreSQL-backed prototype of Provenact, the system prevents stale authorizations missed by baselines that pass policy state as ordinary request context, preserves delayed approvals while unrelated work proceeds, keeps policy evolution mostly in policy text rather than trusted provider code, and avoids policy violations in a scripted, LLM-free procurement workflow where agent-governance baselines produce stale authorizations over shared budgets and inventory. More broadly, Provenact suggests a path for integrating stateful governance boundaries into agent frameworks and provider-backed domains where agents act on shared resources.

</details>


### [436] [Emergence of Biased Consensus in Multi-Agent LLM Debates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02827)
*Maya Okawa*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 这篇论文研究了多智能体LLM辩论中集体偏见（collective bias）的涌现现象，发现噪声（如采样温度）是偏见放大的关键驱动因素，并提出基于物理社会动力学模型的分析框架，预测了从个体偏见到集体偏见存在相变临界点，通过实验验证了该理论预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体LLM辩论虽然在决策任务和问题求解基准上表现优异，但其安全性和公平性风险尚未被充分理解。研究发现交互过程会放大单个LLM的偏见，这引发了对实际部署的担忧，因此需要深入理解这一现象的机制。

Method: 提出一个受物理启发的社会动力学理论模型来分析多智能体LLM辩论，预测当一致性（conformity）超过临界阈值时会出现向集体偏见的相变；通过受控实验验证理论预测，并考察了智能体异质性对该转变的抑制效应。

Result: 观察到与底层相变一致的有限尺寸交叉（finite-size crossover）；发现智能体异质性通过平滑（rounding）该转变来抑制集体偏见的涌现；验证了这些发现在投资决策和LLM-as-a-judge评估等现实任务中的泛化性。

Conclusion: 多智能体LLM辩论中存在从个体偏见到集体偏见的相变现象，噪声是驱动因素，智能体异质性可以缓解这一问题；该框架可用于理解和缓解多智能体LLM系统中的公平性和安全性风险。

Abstract: Multi-agent LLM debates achieve strong performance on decision-making tasks as well as problem-solving benchmarks, yet their safety and fairness risks remain poorly understood. Notably, interaction can amplify the biases of single LLMs, raising concerns for real-world deployment. We identify the emergence of collective (often biased) norms in multi-agent LLM debates and show that noise (e.g., LLM sampling temperature) is a key driver. To explain this, we propose an analytical framework drawing on physics-inspired theoretical models of social dynamics. We predict a phase transition to collective bias when conformity surpasses a critical threshold given the LLMs' initial bias and debate noise. We test the theoretical predictions through controlled experiments and observe a finite-size crossover consistent with an underlying phase transition. We further find that agent heterogeneity suppresses emergence by smoothing (rounding) this transition. Finally, we show that these insights generalize to realistic decision-making tasks, including investment decisions and LLM-as-a-judge evaluation.

</details>


### [437] [SABRE: A Multi-Agent Approach for Selecting Out-of-Distribution Detectors Under a Budget](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02959)
*Mary Wisell,Salimeh Sekeh*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文提出SABRE框架，利用三个语言模型智能体在推理时按领域动态选择最佳的OOD检测器，解决视觉语言模型后验OOD检测在不同领域间失效的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有后验OOD检测假设在基准上选定的检测器在部署后仍然可靠，但作者发现同一冻结编码器上，检测器在不同领域间的表现会发生反转，最好的检测器因领域而异，固定选择无法保证跨领域可靠。

Method: SABRE框架包含三个LM智能体在有限查询预算下协作：Selector选择下一个要咨询的检测器，Reporter整合每个输入的证据，Analyst在部署领域的小型标注样本上校准检测器可靠性（与测试数据不相交）。同时提出四个多模态密度检测器作为检测器库的组成。

Result: SABRE能跟踪每个领域中最强的检测器而无需事先知晓，在传统检测器反转时恢复可靠检测，在检测器可靠时收敛到该检测器。组件分析显示各智能体互补：Reporter的反馈带来持续提升，Analyst的校准对防止反转起决定性作用。

Conclusion: 没有固定规则能跨领域可靠，可靠性必须在部署时建立而非从基准假设，SABRE证明了这一过程可以自动完成。

Abstract: Post-hoc out-of-distribution (OOD) detection for vision-language models assumes that a detector chosen on a benchmark stays reliable once deployed. We show this fails across domains: on a single frozen encoder, a detector that leads in one domain can invert in another, scoring in-distribution inputs as more anomalous than genuine outliers, and the best detector changes from domain to domain, so no fixed choice is reliable throughout. We introduce SABRE (Selective Agentic Budgeted Reliability Ensemble,) which replaces this fixed choice with per-regime selection at inference. Three language-model agents reason over a library of post-hoc detectors under a bounded query budget: a Selector chooses which detector to consult next, a Reporter consolidates the evidence for each input, and an Analyst calibrates detector reliability on a small labeled sample held out from the deployment domain and disjoint from the test data, weighting selection and aggregation without ever observing a scored input's label. The library includes four multimodal density detectors we propose. Inferring the operating regime from data, SABRE tracks the strongest detector in each domain without prior knowledge of it, recovering reliable detection where a conventional detector inverts and converging to that detector where it is sound. A component analysis shows the agents are complementary: the Reporter's feedback yields consistent gains, and the Analyst's calibration is decisive against inversion, ruling out unreliable detectors so that aggregation no longer cancels the sound ones. Since no fixed rule can be trusted across domains, reliability must be established at deployment rather than assumed from a benchmark, and SABRE shows this can be done automatically.

</details>


### [438] [When Truth Is Distributed: Misinformation Derails Collective Fact Recovery in LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03421)
*Chenfei Yan,Zeyang Yue,Feifei Zhao,Erliang Lin,Lu Jia,Haibo Tong,Mingyang Lyu,Chengyi Sun,Yi Zeng*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文提出Hi-Agreement框架，通过严格控制全诚实协作与关键证据持有者欺骗的配对场景，揭示LLM多智能体系统中虚假证据如何通过采纳和传播放大为集体风险，导致真理恢复率从72.50%骤降至14.17%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评估过度关注最终结果，忽视了分布式信息聚合过程中可靠性和传播动态，无法揭示局部错误如何通过通信放大为集体风险。

Method: 构建Hi-Agreement受控评估框架，配对全诚实协作与受控欺骗场景；通过多阶段投票、证词采纳和证据根谱系传播分析聚合过程；在120个五智能体物体移动环境中评估3个同质LLM多智能体系统。

Result: 全部系统中真理恢复率从72.50%降至14.17%；单一虚假证词比真实证词更容易被采纳，传播至更高阶，且在欺骗者退出后仍通过诚实智能体持续存在；无第一手证据的观察者抑制错误共识但无法改善真理恢复。

Conclusion: 分布式事实恢复是脆弱的，其根本机制在于虚假证据一旦进入通信便通过其他智能体的采纳和持续传播获得集体影响力。

Abstract: LLM-based multi-agent systems promise effective collaborative reasoning, but communication may amplify local errors into collective risks. Existing evaluations emphasize final outcomes, leaving the reliability and propagation dynamics of distributed information aggregation unclear. We introduce Hi-Agreement, a controlled evaluation framework that strictly pairs all-honest collaboration with controlled deception by a key evidence holder and analyzes the aggregation process through multi-stage voting, testimony adoption, and evidence-root lineage propagation. Using 120 five-agent object-movement environments where partial observations jointly determine a unique endpoint, we evaluate 3 homogeneous LLM-based multi-agent systems. Across these paired conditions, aggregate truth recovery falls from 72.50% to 14.17%, with significant declines for every system. Process tracing and exit ablations show that a single false testimony is adopted more readily than truthful testimony, propagates to higher orders, and persists through honest agents after the deceiver exits. Observers without first-hand evidence suppress incorrect consensus but do not improve truth recovery. Together, these findings reveal both the fragility of distributed fact recovery and its underlying mechanism: false evidence gains collective influence through its adoption and continued propagation by other agents after entering communication.

</details>


### [439] [Group Perspective Matters: Regulating Debate Relationships Can Mitigate Blind Conformity in Multi-Agent Debate](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03648)
*Hao Wu,Shoucheng Song,Chang Yao,Haoyu Wang,Huaiyu Wan,Youfang Lin,Kai Lv*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文提出DEAR框架，从群体视角动态调控多智能体辩论（MAD）中的辩论关系，以缓解LLM的盲目从众问题，通过两个RL-Agent（选择与行为）进行顺序决策优化，在提升推理性能的同时显著降低token消耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体辩论（MAD）虽能提升LLM推理性能，但LLM极易产生盲目从众行为。现有的个体评估方法（基于置信度或困惑度）无法反映推理正确性，甚至可能加剧盲目从众。因此需要从群体交互视角进行调控。

Method: DEAR框架将LLM间的相互引用定义为"辩论关系"，首先量化共识与分歧作为群体证据以捕捉辩论状态，然后通过三个阶段运作：1) What—感知群体咨询倾向和不确定性；2) Who—引入Select RL-Agent动态选择参考同伴；3) How—采用Behavior RL-Agent自适应调整生成行为。两个RL-Agent的执行为顺序决策过程，通过多智能体强化学习联合优化。

Result: 大量实验表明DEAR在推理性能上达到优越表现，同时显著减少token消耗。

Conclusion: 从群体互动而非个体评估的角度调控辩论关系，是缓解MAD中盲目从众问题的有效途径，DEAR通过动态调节辩论关系实现了性能与效率的双重提升。

Abstract: Multi-Agent Debate (MAD) improves the reasoning performance of Large Language Models (LLMs) through multi-round interaction. However, LLMs in MAD are highly susceptible to blind conformity. Existing individual evaluation methods, typically based on confidence or perplexity, fail to reflect the correctness of reasoning and may even exacerbate blind conformity. To address this, we shift the perspective from individual evaluation to group interaction. We define mutual referencing among LLMs as \textbf{Debate Relationships} and recognize that regulating these relationships is the key to mitigating blind conformity. In this paper, we propose a novel framework for \textbf{D}ynamically r\textbf{E}gulating deb\textbf{A}te \textbf{R}elationships (DEAR) from the group perspective. At first, DEAR quantifies consensus and divergence as \textit{group evidence} to capture the debate state. Then, DEAR operates through three stages: 1) What: perceiving group consultation tendency and uncertainty; 2) Who: introducing a Selection RL-Agent to dynamically select reference peers; and 3) How: adopting a Behavior RL-Agent to adaptively adjust generation behaviors. Notably, we formulate the execution of the two RL-Agents as a sequential decision-making process, jointly optimizing via multi-agent reinforcement learning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DEAR achieves superior performance while significantly reducing token consumption.

</details>


### [440] [An Actionable Diagnosis of Multilingual, Multi-Agent Planning Failures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03735)
*Vikas Pahuja,Jonathan Brokman,Omer Hofman,Tamir Nizri,Daniel Vishna,Seraphina Goldfarb-Tarrant,Kelly Marchisio,Hisashi Kojima,Roman Vainshtein*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文研究了多语言多智能体系统中规划器（planner）作为"请求到行动"接口的失败模式，提出了规划落地失败（planning-grounding failures）的分类法，并引入TART方法（Taxonomy-Guided Actionable Representation）来缓解这些问题，在多语言GAIA基准上平均提升5.6个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多语言多智能体系统在英语之外的语言上性能显著下降，但先前工作很少识别用户请求转换为可执行计划时任务关键信息的丢失机制。作者旨在系统性地理解和缓解这一瓶颈。

Method: 首先从真实失败任务执行中推导出规划-落地失败的可操作分类法（taxonomy）；利用LLM分析发现这些失败在低资源语言中占比增加；基于该分类法设计TART（Taxonomy-Guided Actionable Representation），将分类法中的关键方面显式提供给规划器和下游子智能体。

Result: 在多种语言、三个LLM骨干网络、两个数据集和两种智能体配置下，TART一致地提升了性能。在多语言GAIA上，将最先进系统的准确率在覆盖低资源到高资源的11种语言上平均提升了5.6个百分点。

Conclusion: 规划-落地失败分类法能够有效指导多语言多智能体系统的改进，TART作为一种基于分类法的可操作表示方法，能显著缓解多语言场景下任务关键信息丢失的问题。

Abstract: Multilingual multi-agent systems exhibit substantial degradation beyond English, yet prior work rarely identifies how task-critical information is lost when user requests are converted into executable plans. We study the planner in a multi-agent system as the request-to-action interface and derive an actionable taxonomy of planning-grounding failures from failed real-world task executions. LLM-based analysis shows that these failures constitute an increasing share of unsuccessful executions as language-resource availability declines, with the strongest effects in low-resource languages. To test whether the taxonomy supports mitigation, we introduce TART, Taxonomy-Guided Actionable Representation, that makes the taxonomy's key aspects explicit to the planner and downstream sub-agents. Across multiple languages, three LLM backbones, two datasets, and two agentic configurations, TART consistently improves performance. On multilingual GAIA, it raises a state-of-the-art system's accuracy by 5.6 percentage points averaged across eleven languages spanning low- to high-resource settings.

</details>


### [441] [History Matters: Meta-policy Delegation with Heterogeneous Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03833)
*Ziqing Lu,Avinash Reddy Mudireddy,Sarra Alqahtani,Weiyu Xu*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文研究异构多智能体系统（MAS）中的任务委派与协作问题，提出基于多智能体强化学习（MARL）的委派训练方法，并引入两种新框架：基于交互历史的策略依赖和新型多维货币机制，以在资源受限场景下最小化总执行成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI智能体在未来决策系统中越来越重要，但异构多智能体系统中成员具有不同能力和运营成本，如何在资源受限场景下高效委派任务以最小化总执行成本是一个关键问题。

Method: 1) 基于MARL的委派训练方法，使智能体进行顺序委派决策并最小化总执行成本；2) 扩展到具有指定委派拓扑的MARL；3) 提出第一个框架：策略不仅依赖当前MDP状态，还依赖交互历史（包括先前联合动作），以改善协调；4) 提出第二个框架：新型多维货币机制促进MAS的协作与委派。

Result: 论文提出的方法和框架旨在使多智能体系统在资源受限条件下完成研究任务的同时最小化总执行成本，并改善智能体间的协调效率。

Conclusion: 通过历史依赖的决策制定和货币机制两类新框架，可以有效提升异构多智能体系统在资源受限场景下的协作与委派效率。

Abstract: AI agents are expected to play an increasingly important role in future decision-making systems. In this paper, we consider collaborative systems composed of heterogeneous multi-agent systems (MAS), where their members have different capabilities and operating costs. We study how agents can delegate tasks to one another so that certain research tasks can be completed effectively under resource-constrained scenarios. We first develop a multi-agent reinforcement learning-based (MARL) delegation training that enables agents to make sequential delegation decisions while minimizing the total execution cost. We then extend this approach to MARL with prescribed delegation topologies. Furthermore, we introduce two new frameworks for collaboration and delegation in multi-agent systems. The first framework proposes that an agent's policy depends not only on the current state of the underlying Markov decision process but also on the interaction history, including previous joint actions. This history-dependent formulation can improve coordination even in fully observable environments, where conventional MARL methods typically restrict policies to depend only on the current state. The second framework proposes a novel, potentially multi-dimensional monetary mechanism to facilitate the collaboration and delegation for MAS.

</details>
